name: Foxy Production
notes:
CLOSED. Ended its gallery program in October 2023 after 20 years (final show: Erin Calla Watson, closed 2023-10-08); pivoted to consultancy/curatorial/production work without a physical exhibition space. Retained for registry completeness per project philosophy — closures are data, not errors.

Fingerprint (2026-08-18): sanity — cdn.sanity.io reference in HTML.

Checked live (2026-08-18): the fingerprint match was a single static background-image URL baked into what's now a fully static Hugo-generated site (generator meta tag confirms Hugo 0.85.0) — no live Sanity API call, and the project's public GROQ endpoint returns zero documents for any query. Consistent with the gallery program having ended; stays manual.
